anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before failed every fact because it rejected the course model outright: it had no assess/deliver rows, treated bare `2` as `review`, capped rounds at 5, refused automatic BEHIND sync (stopping at an intermediate wait/update-branch menu before readiness), never renewed the deadline on own pushes (12:17 kept throughout), rendered fixable/fix menus instead of stuck exits for B and C, said re-runs happen outside the gate, and denied any sync record for D. After moved all six to holds: numeric 2 persists course deliver with 2x5 caps before writes, P1 and P2 run as consecutive waves with reviewer closure and no mid-menu, own pushes renew 12:17/12:25/12:27 while the 12:11 base observation is explicitly non-renewing, BEHIND queues the Loop sync without a pick and final offers merge but executes nothing on stop, B and C exit `stuck - red twice without a source change` (C after exactly one re-run, B naming the base sync as the only SHA movement), and D persists wave.sync {pre_head B, expected_remote_head A}, leases against A, and resets to clean B with no second push. Nothing regressed; the only tightening worth considering is stating 'fresh helper' explicitly in the P1/P2 wave rows and the B/C/D stuck tables so f1's helper-freshness clause is visible rather than implied, which can be done by adding 'fresh implementer + fresh reviewer' to the Outcome cell without lengthening the reply.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refused the assess/deliver menu entirely, so every fact failed there; After adopts the course model and delivers f1, f3, f4, f5 and f6 cleanly (single numeric 2, no mid-delivery menu, BEHIND sync without a pick, B/C stuck exits, D's pre_head B / expected_remote_head A lease-and-restore). The one fact After does not satisfy is f2: the table records the 12:02 push with deadline `null` and says 'no watch is admitted and no deadline is minted', and the 12:10 push as 'null at push; 12:25 at first watch', so the deadline is tied to starting a watch rather than to the own push itself, and the 12:02→12:17 renewal never appears. The timeout rule in the Change says the window 'renews only on own push', so the wording should make the own push the minting event unconditionally: e.g. 'Each own push records poll_deadline = push time + 15 minutes (12:02→12:17, 12:10→12:25, 12:12→12:27) whether or not a watch is admitted; a watch only consumes the recorded window, and a base-only observation such as 12:11 neither mints nor renews it.' That keeps the base-observation distinction After already draws while restoring the per-push deadlines f2 requires.
